title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: Spyglass is now officially launched, empowering you with a suite of advanced features to uncover crucial insights and streamline your operations.

title: Master Your Files with Advanced Editor Controls
summary: Take full command of your content by effortlessly managing all your embedded files, uploading new ones, and choosing how they display within the editor.

title: Explore Our Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our new interactive Product Roadmap, providing full transparency into recently shipped features, upcoming releases, and future plans.

title: Supercharged Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved experience with our newly designed checkboxes, now bigger, more clickable, and effortlessly draggable.

title: Seamless Editor Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded our editor's collaboration tools to ensure a seamless and more aware co-editing process for everyone.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Content Discovery
summary: We've made it effortless to find and collaborate on ideas and quests shared with you, ensuring all relevant content is readily accessible for a more productive experience.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with ultimate control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's exciting journey.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to offer comprehensive support for international languages, making our platform accessible and intuitive for users around the world.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Vibrant Themes
summary: Transform your workspace with an array of stunning new themes and polished existing designs, offering unparalleled personalization and visual delight.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Constellation
summary: Navigate and uncover hidden connections within your knowledge base with a redesigned Constellation view featuring advanced filtering by tags, time, and shared items.

title: Precision Search & Knowledge Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your most relevant information by applying powerful new filters and saving your curated selections as personalized knowledge collections.

title: Dynamic Content Connections
summary: Seamlessly organize your ideas and enhance your workflow with dynamic new ways to display and interact with connected content in your notes.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and Enhanced Capabilities
summary: We're thrilled to introduce Noeko with versatile self-hosting capabilities and powerful paid plans, empowering you with ultimate flexibility and advanced features.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Get ready for personalized greetings that perfectly match the time of day, enhancing your welcoming experience.

title: Effortless Tag Organization and Management
summary: Streamline your content management by performing powerful bulk actions directly within tag views, empowering you to quickly unapply tags and organize your items with unprecedented ease.

title: Bring Your Content From Anywhere
